changelog: 🚀 Official First Release (v1.0.0) of Shackle AI — your uncompromising AI-enforced focus assistant!
👀 Smart AI Attention Tracking — Uses your webcam to keep you accountable by detecting when you look away, check your phone, or leave your desk.
🚫 Automatic App & Distraction Blocker — Automatically closes distracting applications, games, and entertainment software during locked focus sessions.
🔊 AI Roasts & Voice Discipline — Plays sarcastic, AI-powered voice callouts to keep you focused whenever you get distracted.
🔥 Streaks, XP & Productivity Leagues — Earn XP for every focused minute, build daily streaks, and compete in Bronze, Silver, and Gold leagues.
📊 Post-Session AI Coaching Reports — Get detailed AI-generated feedback and insights at the end of each session to improve your focus habits.
📚 Dedicated Book Mode — Special low-threshold tracking tailored for reading, studying, and offline work without false alerts.
📜 Focus History & Analytics — Easily review past focus sessions, track your progress over time, and celebrate your streak records.
🔑 Persistent Login — Fixed session clearing on close; Google accounts and settings now persist permanently.
⚡ Unthrottled Performance — Added background renderer flags to prevent timer and telemetry throttling when minimized.
⏱️ Dynamic Trial Lifecycle — Real-time 7-day trial calculation and strict paywall gating across all app tabs.
🔥 Accurate Streak Tracking — Robust calendar-day streak gap calculation with full Rest Protocol protection.
🏆 League Promotion Fixes — Unlocked tier promotion for solo competitors and added real-time Firestore leaderboard XP sync.
🛡️ Guest Mode Gating — Locked-but-visible UI indicators for Shackle Leagues in guest mode.
💳 Production Checkout Integration — Direct in-app links to the official payment and renewal portal.
